facts.value: You must have one set of official transcripts from every college and university from which you earned a bachelor's degree or higher sent to ASU.
If your school(s) cannot send them directly to ASU, you may send them yourself, making sure they meet certain requirements.
Original academic credentials issued by the registrar bearing the original raised or colored seal of the institution and the signature of the institution’s registrar.
Photocopies of original academic credentials verified true copies by a responsible official of the institution or by an education representative of the country’s government or embassy.
Photocopies of original academic credentials certified by a recognized international educational organization.
Any document ASU receives becomes property of ASU and will not be returned to you.
Photocopies certified by a notary public are not official. Scanned copies are also not accepted.
All international transcripts must be submitted in their original language accompanied by an official English translation.
Translations must be literal, complete versions of the originals and must be translated by the issuing university, an official translation service, Ministry of Education, consulate or embassy.
Translations may not be completed by the student. Translations certified by a notary public are not acceptable.
Graduate Admission Services, Arizona State University, 1150 East University Drive Building C, Room 226, Tempe, AZ 85281
Please write your application reference number on all documents and envelopes submitted to ASU to expedite processing.
Materials submitted without your application reference number will delay the processing of your application.
